description: Audit one public page for on-page SEO: title and meta description length, canonical, robots meta, heading structure, missing image alt text, lang, viewport, https, robots.txt and sitemap.xml presence, link counts and word count, each as a pass/fail check with observed evidence and a 0-100 score. Workers AI adds up to three prioritized fixes when available, flagged machine_generated. Only the first HTML document is read; JS-rendered pages may look incomplete. Input: {"url": "..."}. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
name: seo-audit
